extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys, and applicants using classification headings to categorize inventions
extracted.subtask_description: A portion of a patent classification scheme listing classes and subclass headings (classes 16–20) with example subject-matter to guide assignment of patents for optical apparatus, musical instruments, printing/office machinery, stationery/office equipment, and sales/advertising equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 16-06 — Optical apparatus (spectacles, periscopes, mirrors, periscopes, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Class section for optical devices and accessories including spectacles, spectacle frames (bridges, arms), pince-nez, prisms for optical apparatus, refractors, spy-holes for doors, anti-dazzle devices, hinges for spectacles, spyglasses, stereoscopes, sunglasses, telescopes, telescopic gun sights, microscope slides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples and enumerated items: pince-nez; prismes pour appareils optique; refracteurs; canons (viseurs de-); lunettes (montures de lunettes — branches, arcades/bridges); lunettes (optique); anti-aveuglement (anti-dazzle) items; charnieres (hinges); microviseurs de portes (spy-holes); stereoscopes; lunettes anti-soleil (sunglasses); longues-vues, telecopes; viseurs telescopiques de fusils (rifle sights); lamelles pour microscopes (microscope slides). Use this section to classify physical optical instruments and their mounts/frames.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 17-01 — Keyboard instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Keyboard musical instruments and related parts: accordions, concertinas, harmoniums, pianos, organs (including electronic), mechanical pianos, piano keys, stops, pedals, soundboards, registers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: accordions, concertinas, harmoniums, keyboard instruments, keyboards for musical instruments, keys (piano), mechanical pianos, organ pipes, stops (organ), organ registers, pedals (piano), sound boards for pianos. Use for inventions relating to keyboard-based musical instruments or their components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 17-02 — Wind instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Wind (aerophone) musical instruments and parts: bagpipes, bassoons, bugles, clarinets, cornets, euphoniums, flutes, harmonicas, horns (musical and hunting), kazoo, mouth organs, oboes, ocarinas, piccolos, reeds, saxophones, trombones, trumpets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples listed: bagpipes; bassoons; bugles; clarinets; cornets (musical); euphoniums; flutes; harmonicas; horns (musical/bass hunting); kazoo; mouth organs; oboes; ocarinas; piccolos; reeds for musical instruments; saxophones; trombones; trumpets. Classify wind-instrument constructions, components, and accessories here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 17-03 — Stringed instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Stringed musical instruments and associated parts: violins, violoncellos, violas, double bass, guitars, harps, mandolins, ukuleles, bows, tuning pegs, chin rests, strings, peg/tuning mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: banjos; bows for musical instruments; chin rests (violin); double bass; dulcimers; guitars; harps; mandolins; musical instruments (stringed); pegs for stringed instruments; tuning pegs; violin chin rests; violins; violoncellos; zithers. Use for physical constructions, fittings and accessories for stringed instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 17-04 — Percussion instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Percussion musical instruments and related items: bells, small bells, big drums, gongs, kettle drums, marimbas, xylophones, tambourines, triangles, cymbals, drums, percussion instrument collections and related components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: carillons; castanets; chimes; cymbals; drum sticks; big drums (music); gongs; kettle drums (timbales); marimbas; percussion instruments in general; tambo rines; triangles; xylophones. Also covers collective instrument arrangements (batteries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 17-09 — Mechanical musical instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: Mechanical (automatic) musical instruments and devices: barrel organs, music boxes, calliopes, mechanical singing birds (automata), organs with barrels and similar mechanical musical devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: barrel organs; mechanical singing-birds; boxes (music); calliopes; music boxes; organs (barrel); singing birds (automata). Use this subclass for mechanically driven music-playing devices and automata producing music.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 17-99 — Musical instruments — Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous musical-instrument related items and accessories not covered above: conductors' batons, dampers, mutes, tuning forks, whistles for tuning, various small accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples listed: conductors' batons; dampers for musical instruments; mutes; tuning forks; whistles (tuning). Use for ancillary items and small accessories related to musical instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 18-01 — Typewriters and calculating machines
rubrics_metrics.description: Typewriting and non-computer calculating/accounting machines and parts: abacus, accounting machines, adding machines, ballot counting/voting machines, calculating machines (excluding computers), cash registers, checkwriters, typewriter keys, paper guides, platens, ribbons, stenographic machines, stenotypes, typewriter keys/platens/ribbons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: abacus; accounting machines; adding machines; ballot counting or voting machines; calculating machines (except computers); cash registers; checkwriters; typewriter keys; paper guides for typewriters; typewriter platens; ribbons; stenographic machines; stenotypes. Use this section for mechanical/electromechanical office machines related to typing, counting, and similar tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 18-02 — Printing machines
rubrics_metrics.description: Printing and reprographic machines and related apparatus: addressing machines and plates, cancelling machines, casting types machines, duplicators, franking machines, inking apparatus/rollers for printing machines, offset printing machines, presses, stereotyping machinery, type-setting apparatus, typographic machines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: address plates; addressing machines (and plates for them); cancelling machines; machines for casting types; duplicators; franking machines; inking apparatus for printing machinery (rollers); mimeographs; offset system printing machines; presses (printing); stereotype machines and apparatus; typesetting apparatus; typographical machines. Use for mechanical and electrical printing equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 18-03 — Type and type faces (typography)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type, characters and typographical signs for printing and for typewriting/subtitles: alphabets, figures and letters for vehicle registration plates, luminous letters, printing matrices, monograms, typographical signs and characters for film subtitles and typewriters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated items: alphabets (printing characters); letters and figures for vehicle registration plates; luminous letters; printing matrices (type); monograms; printing matrices; characters for subtitling films; typewriter characters. Use for physical or design elements of typefaces, matrices and typographical signs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 18-04 — Bookbinding and finishing machinery
rubrics_metrics.description: Machines and apparatus for bookbinding and finishing: bookbinding machines, envelope opening/closing machines, cutting paper machines, folding machines (bookbinding), guillotines (bookbinding), openers (envelope apparatus), trimmers, printers' stapling machines, stapling/stitching and trimmer devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: bookbinding machines; machines for opening and closing envelopes; paper cutting machines/devices; envelope openers; folding machines (bookbinding); guillotines; stapling machines (printers'); stitchers (bookbinding); trimmers. Use for equipment used in finishing printed materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 18-99 — Printing/office machinery — Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous machines and devices related to printing and office production such as label-applying machines, composing frames, composition tables for printing, document-destroying machines, document sorting machines (except for information retrieval).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: applying labels (machines for); cases (typography); composing frames (typography); tables for printing; destroying documents (machines for); document sorting machines (except for information retrieval); plates for addressing machines. Use for other office/printing machinery not belonging to prior subclasses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-01 — Writing paper
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of writing and printing paper and related stationary pages: aerograms, carbon paper, letter cards, drawing paper, envelopes, mailing wrappers for printed matter/newspapers, newsprint, pay packets, photographic paper, paper for architectural plans, printing paper, safety paper, tracing paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated items: aerogrammes; carbon paper; letter cards; drawing paper; envelopes (stationery); letter cards; wrappers for mailing printed matter; newsprint; pay packets; photographic paper; plans (paper for architectural plans); printing paper; safety paper; tracing paper. Use for classification of inventions/materials related to types of paper and paper products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-02 — Office equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Office equipment and small office apparatus: adhesive tape dispensers, elastic bands, banknote clips, filing boxes, cancelling stamps, card index cabinets (mobile), index guide tabs, coin plates, money boxes (including for counting change), correspondence trays, dampers for office use, numbering devices, dispensers for adhesive tape, paper guides, fasteners, folder/hanging-file hardware.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: adhesive tape dispensers; elastic bands for attaching; banknote clips; filing boxes; cancelling stamps (tools for postmarks); card index cabinets (mobile); index guide tabs; money boxes and coin-counting boxes; correspondence trays; dampers; numbering stamps; paper clips/fasteners; paper punches for office use; staplers and stapling accessories. Use for devices and small articles normally used in office settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-03 — Calendars
rubrics_metrics.description: Calendar-related stationery and accessories: bases for loose-leaf desk diaries, calendar tablets (tear-off type), tear-off calendar holders, diary pages and supports for tear-off calendar tablets, advertising calendars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: bases for loose-leaf desk diaries; calendar tablets (supports for tear-off type); tear-off calendar holders; diary pages (pages for diaries). Also covers calendars used as advertising materials. Use for calendar and diary physical products and supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-04 — Books and book-like objects
rubrics_metrics.description: Books and items similar in outward appearance: accounting books, address books, albums (stamps, photographs, postcards), almanachs, atlases, binders, binding rings, book covers, jackets, booklets, ledgers, magazines, music books, note pads, notebooks, loose-sheet binders, exercise book covers, document folders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated items: accounting books; address books; stamp/photo albums; almanachs; atlases; binders; binding rings; book covers; jackets; booklets; ledgers; magazines; music books; note pads; notebooks; exercise book covers; document folders; pockets/protective sleeves for documents. Use for classification of printed bound products and related covers/cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-05 — Cards for correspondence and announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Greeting, announcement and postcard products: announcement cards (weddings), greeting cards, mourning cards, picture postcards, illustrated postcards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: faire-part (announcement cards); cartes de voeux (greetings cards); cartes de condoleances (mourning/condolence cards); picture postcards (illustrated). Use for classification of greeting/announcement/postcard printed matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-06 — Materials and instruments for hand-writing, drawing, painting, engraving and artistic techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Handwriting/drawing/painting/sculpture/engraving supplies and instruments: ball-point pens, protractors, blackboard erasers/boards, blotters, canvas stretchers, cartridges for drawing ink, chalk holders, compasses, crayons/pencils, pen holders, easels, palettes, paint boxes/kits, lead sharpeners, mechanical pencils, nibs, inkwells, fountain pens, pencil sharpeners, pyrography tools, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive enumeration: pens (ball-point, fountain, stylos), pencil/proppelling pencils, mechanical pencils, compasses, compasses for drawing, rulers, T-squares, easels, palettes, paint boxes, watercolor kits, cartridges for drawing ink, nibs, pen holders and racks, pencil boxes, sharpeners, erasers, blotting pads. Also engraving styli (including electric), pyrography/thermocauteries, pantographs and other drawing machines. Use for classification of art and writing tools and supplies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-07 — Teaching materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Teaching and educational materials: astronomical globes and maps (terrestrial and celestial), planetariums, planispheres (for navigation), apparatus for learning to read (excluding audio-visual aids), road maps, teaching materials generally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: astronomical globes; geographical maps; terrestrial globes; planispheres for navigation; planetariums; apparatus for learning to read (except audio-visual aids); road maps. Use for physical educational aids and printed teaching materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-08 — Other printed matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Various printed matter not otherwise classified: cards for registering absences, accounting sheets, advertising insets/placards/posters, architects' plans, bank checks, calculating tables, identification and visiting cards, parking discs, patterns for dressmaking, test pictures for oculists' instruments, timetables, registration plate transfers, seals for letters, medical prescription pads, musical paper, newspapers, tags and templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated items: absences cards; accounting sheets; advertising insets (posters); advertising placards; album leaves printed; architects' plans; bank checks; calculating tables; credit/identification cards; parking discs; dressmaking patterns; test pictures for oculists; posters; printed matter including advertising; railway timetables; registration plate transfers; seals for letters; medical prescription pads; music paper; newspapers; templates for cutting. Use for a wide variety of printed products and specialized printed forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 19-99 — Stationery/office equipment — Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous stationery and office-related items: album leaves fitted with pockets, adhesive binding strips used as stationery, book markers, calculators (discs), coin collectors' filing pages, conversion slide rules, folders for film negatives, newspaper holders for reading, label strings, binding strips (adhesive stationery), page turners, slide rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: album leaves fitted with pockets; adhesive strips for binding (being stationery); book markers; discs for calculators; filing pages for coin collectors; slide rules for conversion of Anglo-Saxon to metric; folders for film negatives; newspaper holders; label strings; strip binding. Use for assorted stationery articles and accessories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 20-01 — Automatic vending and change apparatus
rubrics_metrics.description: Automatic vending and change machines: change apparatus (money), automatic cigarette vending machines, automatic machines for dispensing drinks, ice-cream cones, sweets, coin-operated ticket/dispenser machines, money changing machines, railway ticket machines, slot machines, vending machines (coin-operated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: change apparatus (money); cigarettes (automatic machines for dispensing); dispensing drinks (automatic machines for); dispensing ice-cream cones; money changing machines; railway ticket machines; slot machines; vending machines (coin-feed automatic). Use for mechanical/electromechanical vending and coin/change apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 20-02 — Display and sales equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Display, sales and merchandising equipment: display racks and units (for thread, postcards, books, magazines, newspapers), dispensers for string/packaging paper, shop stands/stalls, show cases, mannequins (tailors' dummies), fuel/petrol pumps for service stations, shade/colour cards for hair dyes and makeup, pick-up needles display units, presentation pedestals for fashion articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated items: bobbins of thread (display units); dispensers for string/wrapping paper; display racks for books/magazines/postcards/newspapers; stalls (open-air); sales stands; shop mannequins/dummies; fuel pumps (service stations); shade cards for hair dyes; makeup shade charts; show cases for watches; display stands for bottles/millinery/ready-made clothes; tie racks; presentoirs; pedestals for display. Use for retail display and merchandising hardware.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class 20-03 — Signs, signboards and advertising devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Signs, signboards, and advertising devices, including static and mobile luminous advertising panels and animated advertising apparatus: advertisement hoardings, luminous panels, billboards, animated advertising apparatus, barber poles, boundary markers for hunting/fishing reservations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerated examples: advertisement hoardings; advertisements (luminous panels for); advertising devices (luminous or not, mobile or static); animated advertising apparatus; barber poles; billboards; boundary markers for hunting and fishing reservations. Use for construction, illumination, animation and mounting of advertising signage.
